== Summary ==
Identified: [[Jim Li]], [[Anthony Lawrence]]. Only Jim; ALaw is Anthony Lawrence. Which is which not marked.

== Description ==

Game 3: [[Jim Li]] vs [[Anthony Lawrence]]. At the [[June 2003 Columbia Heights tournament (1 June)]], Twin City Comics, Columbia Heights, Minnesota, 1 June 2003.

== Source and credit ==

Shared by [[Nick Kolnik]] (bluethrawn) on his MNSWCCG website; announced in [http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=28220#28220 post 28220] in "2003 Minnesota SW:CCG State Championship Weekend" (topic 1291), 1 June 2003.
